newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 7.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 7.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
Smaller ships were warned of high waves and wind speeds along the coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz in the Gulf of Mexico.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clouds on the northern coast with isolated light rains and winds 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour). Rest of coast with lighter winds and clear skies.

Moderate cold front moving toward Tamaulipas state, bringing rains and colder weather to region. Winds from 15 to 20 knots with waves six to nine feet high and further down the Gulf 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with moderate winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
